method: negative controls for layout/erc-report.json: one klt erc run per row against a perturbed scratch copy of layout/erc-spec.json (or, for the stream_second_vdd_label row, of layout/comparator.gds) -- neither committed artifact is written to. Each row asserts the exact set of erc_findings rules AND the exact set of erc_coverage.skipped reasons that perturbation must produce, because a supply check reports nothing both when it is clean and when it was never asked.

probes.perturbation: the n-well tie declares net GND instead of VDD
probes.reads_as: the tie check verifies WHICH net the tap reaches, not merely that a tap exists

findings.description: well/tub tap is not connected to declared net 'GND'

probes.perturbation: the substrate tie's tap narrowed by tap_boxes to a 1x1um region with no tap geometry in it
probes.reads_as: a tap assertion matching no drawn geometry is an honest 'no tap' finding, not a silent pass

findings.description: well/tub region has no 'psub_gnd' tap contact drawn inside it

probes.perturbation: the asserted substrate region split into two disjoint bands, only one of which holds the tap
probes.reads_as: EVERY asserted substrate polygon must independently contain a tap that reaches the net -- one tap does not cover the die

findings.description: well/tub region has no 'psub_gnd' tap contact drawn inside it

probes.perturbation: the met1<->met2 via role removed from the stackup, cutting both rails at every layer change
probes.reads_as: a rail severed between met1 and met2 is caught -- and caught on the TIE rule, because the label-bearing island survives (see stream_second_vdd_label)

findings.description: well/tub tap is not connected to declared net 'VDD'

probes.perturbation: diff (65/20) declared as a conductor role, so every MOS source conducts to its own drain
probes.reads_as: the supply-short rule bites: VDD and GND resolving to one island is reported, so the committed run's two islands are a measurement

findings.description: declared nets 'GND' and 'VDD' are electrically the same net (shorted together)

probes.perturbation: a third supply net 'VPWR' declared, which nothing in the stream labels
probes.reads_as: a declared supply matching no labelled geometry is reported rather than passing vacuously

findings.description: declared net 'VPWR' matches no labelled geometry in this layout

probes.perturbation: tap_is_dedicated dropped from both ties, leaving the tap region 'whatever 65/44 draws inside the well'
probes.reads_as: klayout-tools#2199's unfalsifiability rejection fires against THIS spec -- zero findings, but the work is recorded as skipped and item 11 would render supply_spec_incomplete

probes.perturbation: the asserted substrate region widened to the whole top-cell extent
probes.reads_as: klayout-tools#2255's counterpart rejection: 'the entire die is the substrate' is skipped work, not a clean tie

probes.perturbation: a second VDD label drawn on met1.pin over the CLK label, in a scratch copy of the GDS
probes.reads_as: the multi-island branch bites -- and bounds the rule: klt counts islands CARRYING THE LABEL, so a one-label rail can never report a labelled/orphan split

findings.description: declared net 'VDD' resolves to 2 disconnected electrical islands (expected exactly one)

signoff_if_cited.method: klt signoff --manifest <scratch copy of manifests/sky130-comparator.json with an item-11 citation of layout/erc-report.json + layout/lvs-report.json> --tiers-doc manifests/design-evidence-tiers.md. The committed manifest is NOT modified: this row records what the grader would say, so 'left uncited' is a disclosed choice rather than an ungradeable envelope. Why the choice went that way is in layout/README.md -> 'Why item 11 is left uncited'.
